page.overview:
Who is Tina Doyle?

Tina Doyle is a character who appears in the comic Halloween: 30 Years of Terror.

Tina Doyle is the wife of Tommy Doyle, a horror comic book writer. She did not share Tommy's love of the comics and did not want their son Jamie exposed to them. She nagged him constantly about leaving them laying around.
